summary: Current bounded correction: remove unsupported earnings impressions, explain complete cost coverage and offer clearly hypothetical margin budgets. The cases group 38 automated tests and observed browser procedures; they are not all separate automated tests.
Earlier reviews are historical evidence in the source package. They do not validate the corrected model merely because arithmetic once passed.
method: Automated: Node calculation/source regression tests and TypeScript checking. Browser: native cloud-Chrome form, keyboard, navigation and share actions.

Responsive review at 320, 390, 440 and 1280px widths with default or 200% root text. The 15px scrollbar is reflected in reported content widths. No physical Safari, screen-reader or native zoom verification is claimed.
Public accounting context rechecked against the cited SEC filing, Note 8 p.F-40 and compute/infrastructure discussion p.147. Those figures never populate OpenAI cost inputs.
changes: Actual provider costs start unknown. No default earnings-like result.
Serving infrastructure, research/model development, people and company operations are visible before calculations.
10/15/20 percent scenarios calculate required total cost budgets, not estimated OpenAI margins.
Optional operating-cost balance requires explicit inputs and review for current usage; changing costs or usage invalidates review.
Earlier scenario links clear incomplete provider cost examples with an explanation. Connected Markdown, JSON, chapters and source package use the corrected model.

cases.title: Unknown costs and explicit zero
cases.action: Exercise missing, null, nonfinite, negative and explicitly zero costs.
cases.expected: Missing costs block balances and loyalty outputs; intentional zero is allowed.
cases.actual: All unknown/review gates passed; unknown does not silently become zero.

cases.title: Receipt continuity and target budgets
cases.action: Test tier boundaries, high usage, donations and 0/10/15/20/100 percent targets.
cases.expected: Revenue uses the unchanged billing rule; budget plus hypothetical surplus reconciles.
cases.actual: At a 1,000 bill, the 15 percent target allows 850 total costs and 150 surplus. Donations never enter revenue.

cases.title: Cost coverage, stale review and losses
cases.action: Vary serving, development, operations and payment costs; change usage within and across tiers.
cases.expected: All allocations count once; stale or unreviewed inputs yield null; losses stay negative.
cases.actual: Reviewed 100 revenue minus 40/30/10/3 gives 17; raising development to 80 gives -33. Usage changes invalidate review.

cases.title: Shared links and legacy correction
cases.action: Round-trip v4 reviewed and incomplete scenarios; parse v1/v2/v3 links and malformed flags.
cases.expected: Partial data remains incomplete; old cost examples cannot revive an earnings-like result.
cases.actual: Receipt and advanced comparisons retained; earlier provider assumptions cleared with a correction message.

cases.title: Source, equations and public accounting
cases.action: Run all existing and new calculation/source tests and TypeScript checking.
cases.expected: No billing or corpus regression; benchmark reconciles without supplying cost inputs.
cases.actual: 38 Node tests passed; TypeScript passed. Public benchmark totals and ratios reconcile. Canonical source hash unchanged.

cases.title: First view and mobile context
cases.action: Open economics at 440px default text and inspect its reading order.
cases.expected: Explain revenue, cost coverage and limits before any results.
cases.actual: A bill isn’t profit, serving/development/operations and actual-cost uncertainty precede hypothetical target budgets. No default provider balance. 425px content/viewport widths.

cases.title: Cost inputs and keyboard calculation
cases.action: At 1280px, enter 40 serving, 30 development, 10 operations and 3 percent fees; activate review with Enter.
cases.expected: Blank inputs disable review; completed inputs require confirmation.
cases.actual: No result before review; after Enter, the ledger reconciles to 17. Desktop screenshot retained.

cases.title: Cleared cost and negative balance
cases.action: Clear development; then enter 80 and review.
cases.expected: Unknown removes the result; high costs can produce a loss.
cases.actual: Empty field removed the balance; reviewed 80 development produced -33.

cases.title: Share, navigation and increased usage
cases.action: Copy/open the cost scenario, navigate to the receipt and increase metered use to 1,000.
cases.expected: Entered costs survive navigation but cannot automatically support a larger-bill result.
cases.actual: Copied link used v4 with review status. Allocations survived reload; the 1,000 bill showed no balance and asked for another cost review. Target budgets became 900/850/800.

cases.title: Clear assumptions preserves the bill
cases.action: Clear cost assumptions after the 1,000 bill.
cases.expected: All costs revert to unknown; the receipt is retained.
cases.actual: All four inputs blank with Unknown placeholders; provider bill remained 1,000.

cases.title: Legacy misleading link
cases.action: Open v3 use=1000 with servingCost=50, otherCosts=5 and paymentFee=3.
cases.expected: Do not display the old 915 residual.
cases.actual: Bill remained 1,000; visible cost-model correction; no provider balance element.

cases.title: Enlarged mobile and desktop
cases.action: Inspect 320px and 1280px at 200 percent root text; enter explicit zero at narrow size.
cases.expected: Text, cards and fields reflow; unknown categories remain missing.
cases.actual: No page-wide overflow: 305/305 and 1265/1265 widths. Zero accepted for serving; the other three remained unknown. Screenshots retained.

cases.title: Connected archive
cases.action: Open the economics archive at 390px default text.
cases.expected: The same target-budget distinction and cost model appear without JavaScript.
cases.actual: Updated explanation visible; 375px content/viewport widths. Readable HTML, Markdown and JSON regenerated.

cases.title: Physical mobile touch and Safari
cases.expected: Confirm behavior on those devices and settings.
cases.actual: Not performed. Responsive cloud-Chrome review and root-font scaling are not a substitute.

cases.title: Screen-reader behavior
cases.action: Use VoiceOver or NVDA through the changed cost UI.
cases.expected: Confirm behavior on those devices and settings.
cases.actual: Not performed. Responsive cloud-Chrome review and root-font scaling are not a substitute.

cases.title: Native browser/OS enlargement
cases.action: Test real browser zoom and operating-system text settings.
cases.expected: Confirm behavior on those devices and settings.
cases.actual: Not performed. Responsive cloud-Chrome review and root-font scaling are not a substitute.
